title: AnswerLayer
description: AnswerLayer maintains an existing answer, policy, workflow, recommendation, or assumption set as reality changes. New evidence is compared with a dated baseline to determine whether it is noise, confirmation, contradiction, or a material change.
notes:
Copy the .zip from "Additional Files" to your Codex, Claude Code, or other harness (or add the .zip file to a knowledge base of a project on Chat) and install the contained Augment Agent SKILL. The prompt this post contains has a clean install and onboarding process but is not required. Hit copy to clipboard and paste to your harness in chat with the .zip file.

Bring the current baseline, its as-of date and purpose, the new evidence, and what would count as a meaningful change.
AnswerLayer maintains an existing answer; for open-ended investigation with no baseline, start with a research tool first.
It can produce an updated version and future recheck trigger. Publishing the change or setting up ongoing monitoring remains a separate action.
